title: Click Guard → Traffic at a glance

steps.caption: Dashboard
steps.narration: The Dashboard sums up the traffic your tracking code saw, for the dates you pick.

steps.caption: Pick the range
steps.narration: Choose Daily, Last 7 days or Last 30 days.

steps.caption: Visits, blocked, unique, per visitor
steps.narration: Visits, Blocked IPs, Unique visitors and Visits per visitor update for that range.

steps.caption: Threat level
steps.narration: Threat level is the share of visits that were flagged.

steps.caption: Visit trend
steps.narration: Visit trend shows each day's visits, so a spike stands out.

steps.caption: Visits by device
steps.narration: Visits by device: mobile, desktop and tablet, with the share of each.

steps.caption: Browser breakdown
steps.narration: Browser breakdown does the same for browsers.

steps.caption: Traffic sources
steps.narration: Traffic sources lists the sites that sent each visit.

steps.caption: Sources, page loads, visitors
steps.narration: How many sources, page loads and visitors, for the same ranges.

steps.caption: The biggest source
steps.narration: Each source has its share, its page loads and its visitors, biggest first.

steps.caption: Traffic signals
steps.narration: Under Traffic signals, the other tabs break the same visits down.

steps.caption: Countries
steps.narration: Countries shows where visits came from.

steps.caption: Multi-Clicks
steps.narration: Multi-Clicks counts how many visitors came once, twice, or ten times and more.

steps.caption: Menu: Dashboard
steps.narration: It all starts on the Dashboard, first in the Click Guard menu.

youtube.title: How to read your ad traffic in Click Guard | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A look at the traffic numbers in Click Guard in ConstructHUB: visits, unique visitors, blocked IPs and the share flagged for the range you pick, the daily visit trend, visits by device and browser, the sites that sent each visit, and the country and multi-click breakdowns under Traffic signals.
